package.description: A tool for a photogrammetry pipeline, especially for archaeologists and UAV.

en-US.description: A tool for a photogrammetry pipeline, especially for archaeologists and UAV.
en-US.longDescription: It is widely used by archaeologists. Many UAV companies are also using it. The software is available in Standard and Pro versions, the standard version is sufficient for interactive media tasks, while the Pro version is designed for authoring GIS content. Note that it does not work on the Home N or Pro N versions of Windows.
en-US.name: Metashape Standard
